component.name: MagneticDetumble
component.comment: Component for spacecraft detumbling using magnetic torquers. Implements B-dot control law.

port.name: angularVelocityIn
port.comment: Input for current angular velocity vector

port.name: magneticFieldIn
port.comment: Input for current magnetic field vector

port.name: dipoleRequestOut
port.comment: Output for commanded magnetic dipole moment

channel.name: angularVelocity
channel.comment: Current angular velocity vector used in control law

channel.name: magneticField
channel.comment: Current magnetic field vector used in control law

event.name: DetumbleInitialized
event.format_string: MagneticDetumble component initialized with gain k! = %f

event.name: MagFieldNearZero
event.format_string: Magnetic field magnitude (%f T) is near zero. Commanding zero dipole.
event.comment: Magnetic field magnitude is too small for reliable control.

event.name: DipoleSaturated
event.format_string: Commanded dipole moment (%f, %f, %f A*m^2) exceeds saturation limit of %f A*m^2. Outputting clamped value.
event.comment: Commanded magnetic dipole moment was saturated.

event.name: ParameterUpdate
event.format_string: Control parameter %s updated to %f. Recalculated gain k! = %f
